subject: Consulate packet assembly for Acme exec workshop — invitation & SOW needed
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lina Costa <lina@globalconcierge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: Consulate packet assembly for Acme exec workshop — invitation & SOW needed

Hi Lina,

We have an exec-level on-site workshop with Acme Financial in Lisbon (Jan 17-18, 2027). Procurement at Acme has asked for "embassy-ready" invitation materials we can attach to visa applications for two visiting Redwood execs: myself (Indian passport) and Monica (US passport).

Can you put together: 
- A formal invitation letter on Redwood letterhead signed by legal/ops that explicitly lists dates, purpose (product workshop + integration planning), and invited attendees and their roles. We need wording suitable for Portuguese consulate review.
- A short SOW (1–2 pages) describing the engagement scope, venue, and billing information (Acme procurement will attach to the visa packet).
- A single combined PDF we can upload to Acme's procurement portal.

Timing: Acme's procurement team asks for documents by EOD Nov 11 so they can included them in the internal packet. Can you confirm your timeline and any specific passport/ID formats you need (scan resolution, file name conventions)?

I have attached the Acme purchase order and a draft attendee list for reference. Please advise if you need any additional attestation language (e.g., cost responsibility, travel support).

Thanks — Priyom

Attachments: PO_12345_Acme.pdf (stub), attendee_list.csv (stub)

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
pri***@redwood.com | +1 (555) 212-0912

From: Lina Costa <lina@globalconcierge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 13:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Consulate packet assembly for Acme exec workshop — invitation & SOW needed

Hi Priyom —

We can do that. Plan and timeline below: 

1) Redwood Invitation Letter (formal) — draft within 24 hours, final PDF within 48 hours once you confirm attendee names + passport numbers. Letter will include: event dates, host (Acme Financial), purpose, specific attendee names/roles, and statement that Redwood will not be financially responsible for visa costs unless otherwise agreed. We can add a line about company sponsorship if you prefer.

2) SOW — 1–2 page engagement summary with venue, agenda highlights, point-of-contact, and billing/PO reference. Draft by EOD Nov 10.

3) Combined Embassy Packet PDF — we will assemble and deliver by Nov 11 EOD.

Required from you: clear scans of passport pages (photo page) for both attendees, preferred file names, and a contact person at Acme to include as host contact.

Suggested file naming: Lastname_Firstname_Passport_{country}_{YYYYMMDD}.pdf (e.g., Das_Priyom_Passport_IND_20261109.pdf)

I can provide an optional notarization add-on and an apostille guidance note for Portugal — let me know if you want us to route for notarization (extra 2–3 business days).

Would you like us to include the SOW as an appendix inside the invitation PDF or as a separate document? Some consulates prefer a single combined PDF.

Regards,
Lina
Global Concierge — Embassy Services
Lina Costa | lina@globalconcierge.com | +351 21 555 0100

Attachments: itinerary_stub.ics (stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Lina Costa <lina@globalconcierge.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, João Silva <joao.silva@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Consulate packet assembly for Acme exec workshop — invitation & SOW needed

Thanks, Lina — attaching the passport scans and the short SOW draft. Please combine into one embassy-ready PDF and include the host contact info below in the letter.

Host contact (Acme):
João Silva — Head of IT Integrations
joao.silva@acmefinancial.com | +351 91 777 8900

Passport scans attached (low-res stubs included here; full scans in the attached PDF):
- Das_Priyom_Passport_IND_20261109.pdf
- Patel_Monica_Passport_USA_20261109.pdf

SOW summary attached as Acme_Redwood_SOW_Jan2027.docx — key bullets are workshop objectives, proposed agenda, and deliverables (post-workshop integration plan + exec brief). Please include PO# 12345 in the SOW.

Also: Acme procurement prefers a line that the invited employees are "temporary visitors for business purposes" and that Redwood will be available as a point-of-contact for verification. Feel free to mirror their suggested language below: 

"The above-named individuals are invited to participate in a business workshop in Lisbon on Jan 17–18, 2027. Redwood Inference confirms the visit is temporary for business purposes and will make company representatives available should the consulate need to verify the invitation."

Let me know when the PDF is ready and whether you recommend notarization for Portuguese consulate acceptance.

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_SOW_Jan2027.docx, passport_scans_priyom_monica.pdf

--
Priyom

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lina Costa <lina@globalconcierge.com>, João Silva <joao.silva@acmefinancial.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Consulate packet assembly for Acme exec workshop — invitation & SOW needed

Hi all — quick confirmation: Acme procurement asked us to deliver the final combined PDF by EOD Nov 11 (their portal cut-off). Lina — if you can deliver the combined PDF plus a single signed invitation (Redwood letterhead) and the SOW as appendix by 20:00 UTC today we will upload immediately and notify procurement.

Also, please name the combined PDF: ACME_Packet_Redwood_Jan2027_{Lastname}.pdf (we will upload per-attendee with the matching passport file).

If notarization is required we will escalate, but please flag it in your deliverable so we can make a quick decision.

Thank you — Monica
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (555) 303-4450

Attachments: none
